title: 2022-09-22 Meeting regarding planners and CMS hosted on Cybercomhosting
content:
Attendees:

There are currently still solutions being hosted on cybercomhosting as well as having dependencies towards Jenkins and CMS that are locked behind an old cybercom AD. In an effort to move all IKEA solutions to IKEA owned & administered environments we want to figure out the effort required to do so. There is also a growing risk of the environments becoming orphaned since access is tied to a decomissioned AD that is very complicated to access.

The folllowing planners & tools are using the CMS and/or Jenkins today:

  • BYOx

  • Sofa

  • Coro2

  • Vidga

  • Serie-galleriet

  • kiosk-admin-tool

  • Byggis

Serie-galleriet & kiosk-admin-tool are supposed to be replaced by IPEX Gallery. Some users may still be using these tools for other purposes, for example links to planners etc. According to IPEX Gallery does not have a set date for a world wide rollout, however as I understood it all markets can get it now should they want to. So it shouldn’t be a hindrance to closing down Serie-galleriet and kiosk-admin-tool.

The CMS contains two parts, the one that is used by most planners on the above list and one that is specific to Coro2.

added the following in a chat:

“Regarding the cms it has always afaik been maintained solely by the dev leads and there is no data base, just static files. So that basically means that it does not need to be hosted anywhere other than localhost.

The actual content (data/configuration) was split from the main repository long ago so that each team would own their own data and only the application (angular FE, nodejs BE) was in the main repository. There are installation scripts to checkout the content for each planner.

So, maintaining the content shouldn't be much trickier than today, just that it would not be available for everyone to see, but not sure if anyone does that anyway (ux, tester?)” According to the attendees there is currently not a use case for the ux & tester concern Tobias raised.

With this in mind we should be able to build a github action to run the cms work and host it on Azure. We will need to create a repo to hold this as well as a space on Akamai to host the files. & offered to help facilitate this.

Coro2 is fairly old, is there an EoL that is fairly imminent and as such we should not move it? may be best suited to answer this.

kiosk-admin-tool is easy to fix, should it be deemed to remain in production.

  • Akamai space

  • Migrate builds from Jenkins to Github Actions

  • Migrate code to Github

  • Update communication on internal pages like Toolbox

  • Ensure teams have access

DEXF “future date” needs to survive. It’s in use by the mentioned planners as well as Skytta and Kombinera. This includes the future query proxy.

A concern mentioned in the meeting was that if we move away from the current setup, we will lose the ability to see how changes affect planners.

Sleep also has image scripts that downloads releases from Rapidimages, runs verification and then uploads to Akamai. These scripts runs for every range update and needs to be migrated if we are to close cybercomhosting.com

mentioned in relation to kiosk-admin-tool that MANY markets are using this tool. We can’t just turn it off since Gallery is lacking functionality that kiosk-admin-tool has.
